lines.trans: Senya, look how the caviar shines!
I told you, the dye is great.
It looks like genuine black caviar.
This dish is called pike easter.
Why specifically pike easter?
Because it is a real culinary miracle!
Give me a spoon, I want to taste.
Taste a tiny bit, just do not eat it all.
Listen, the taste is simply magnificent.
Our guests will be in total delight.
The main thing is that Chef suspects nothing.
Chef will not find out anything, hide the jar!

examples.text: Я устал, потому что много работал.
examples.trans: I'm tired because I worked a lot.
I'm at home because I'm ill.

meanings.note: красная икра = red (salmon) caviar, чёрная икра = black caviar

examples.text: Мама говорила, что у меня на икру аллергия.
examples.trans: Mum said I'm allergic to caviar.

meanings.note: a particular prepared food item or meal course

examples.text: Настоящий повар чувствует каждый вкус блюда.
examples.trans: A real chef feels every taste of the dish.

examples.text: Осталось ровно три минуты до готовности блюда.
examples.trans: Exactly three minutes remain until the dish is ready.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: I'm calling to say thank you.
So that there are witnesses, Samson.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Все гости были в полном восторге от ужина.
examples.trans: All the guests were completely delighted with the dinner.

examples.text: Мои гости будут в полном восторге!
examples.trans: My guests will be in total delight!

examples.text: Главное, чтобы шеф ничего не заподозрил.
examples.trans: The main thing is that Chef suspects nothing.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('magnificent, splendid').

examples.trans: A magnificent idea from an unknown person.

examples.text: Муж подарил ей великолепный букет цветов.
examples.trans: Her husband gave her a magnificent bouquet of flowers.

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun
neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.
The most important thing is the people.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

examples.text: Слушай, Самсон, я тут подумал. Твой начальник — такой опытный специалист.
examples.trans: Listen, Samson, I've been thinking. Your boss is such an experienced specialist.

meanings.en: to try, to taste (food or drink)

examples.trans: Try the tea with bread rings.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

examples.text: Паша, я больше не хочу о ней слышать. Понял?
examples.trans: Pasha, I don't want to hear about her again. Understood?

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'личный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('excellent').

examples.text: Квартира будет отличная. На Симашко есть новый дом.
examples.trans: It'll be an excellent flat. There's a new building on Simashko Street.

examples.text: Скоро. А пока я есть хочу, слона бы съел!
examples.trans: Soon. But for now I'm hungry, I could eat an elephant!
Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.note: connected with cooking or the kitchen

examples.text: Я отличный повар и закончил кулинарный колледж.
examples.trans: I am an excellent cook and finished culinary college.

examples.text: Ладно, сейчас проверим твои настоящие кулинарные навыки.
examples.trans: Fine, now we will test your real culinary skills.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: не в моём вкусе = not my type
не в моём вкусе = not my type

examples.text: Я бы рад вам помочь. Но вы, к сожалению, не в моём вкусе.
examples.trans: I would be glad to help you. But unfortunately you are not my type.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: of things, places, films: 'как называется ...?' = what is ... called?

examples.trans: The operation is called Golden Yard.

examples.text: Товарищ генерал, операция называется Золотой ярд.
examples.trans: Comrade General, the operation is called Golden Yard.

examples.text: Потому что это настоящее кулинарное чудо!
examples.trans: Because it is a real culinary miracle!

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry
at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

examples.text: Преступники прятали у слепых плохую траву!
examples.trans: Criminals were hiding bad herbs at the blind society!
What are you hiding behind your back?

examples.text: Пишут, что преступники прятали у слепых плохую траву!
examples.trans: They write that criminals were hiding bad herbs at the blind society!

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'стоящий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('real, genuine').

examples.text: Ваня, да пойми ты наконец! Это настоящий успех.
examples.trans: Vanya, understand at last! This is real success.

meanings.en: to shine, to glisten, to sparkle
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to shine, to glisten', paired with 'блеснуть'.

examples.text: Оно действительно очень красивое и блестит.
examples.trans: It really is very beautiful and shines.
Senya, look how the caviar shines!

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'знать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to recognise; to find out', paired with 'узнавать'.

examples.trans: I'll find out where he is.
You recognised me. Thanks for seeing me.

meanings.note: вот именно = that's just it, quite right

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.

examples.text: Вот именно. Но мне сдаваться нельзя.
examples.trans: Exactly. But I must not give up.

meanings.note: чайная ложка = teaspoon, столовая ложка = tablespoon

examples.trans: He eats soup with a spoon.
And take his eye out with a spoon.
This dish is called pike easter.

examples.text: Щучья икра очень вкусная и полезная.
examples.trans: Pike roe is very tasty and healthy.

examples.text: Это отличная щучья икра, пять килограммов.
examples.trans: This is excellent pike caviar, five kilograms.

examples.text: На столе стоял полный стакан воды.
examples.trans: A full glass of water stood on the table.

examples.text: Ну что я тебе скажу, Аркаша? Это полный кошмар!
examples.trans: Well, what can I tell you, Arkasha? This is a total nightmare!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'глядеть'). Used as an verbal verb meaning 'to look, appear'.

examples.trans: On top the costume looks simply super!

examples.text: Не говорите так, вы прекрасно выглядите!
examples.trans: Do not say that, you look wonderful!
What dye will you paint it with?

examples.text: Я же говорил тебе, краска отличная.
examples.trans: I told you, the dye is great.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('black').

examples.trans: Listen, look in the black cabinet.

examples.text: На нём был строгий чёрный костюм.
examples.trans: He was wearing a formal black suit.

examples.text: Как не нашла? Послушай, в чёрном шкафу посмотри. Там справа от двери!
examples.trans: What do you mean you didn't find it? Listen, look in the black cabinet. There to the right of the door!

meanings.en: a little bit, just a little
meanings.note: Core Russian adv meaning 'a little bit, slightly' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Нам нужно чуть-чуть потерпеть и немножко поработать.
examples.trans: We need to be patient a little and work a bit.
Wait just a little bit longer.

examples.text: Послушай меня, Ваня. Нам нужно чуть-чуть потерпеть и немножко поработать.
examples.trans: Listen to me, Vanya. We need to be patient a little and work a bit.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'Easter' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Я буду ждать его до следующей Пасхи?
examples.trans: Am I going to wait for it until next Easter?

examples.text: Это прямо настоящая щучья пасха получается.
examples.trans: This turns out to be a real pike Easter.

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look

examples.trans: Can I go and have a look?
Hide the jar under the table!
The supplier will bring the jar in an hour.

examples.text: Шеф ничего не узнает, прячь банку!
examples.trans: Chef will not find out anything, hide the jar!
